verse.text: Work willingly at whatever you do, as though you were working for the Lord rather than for people.

video.title: What I Do, I Do for Jesus | Colossians 3:23–24 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Whether it's grinding through a shift, fixing the leaky faucet, or coaching your kid's little league team, the way you show up for the 'small stuff' teaches your family what integrity looks like. Dad, when you work heartily as if Christ himself is watching — not to impress anyone, not just to collect a paycheck — you model a legacy of diligence your kids will carry into their own lives. Let today's ordinary tasks become quiet acts of worship.
